history.name: Every edition is measured against the one before it
history.description: An edition highlights what is different from the edition that preceded it, however long ago that was — which is what makes a printed edition reproduce the conversation it was printed for, rather than being rewritten by later work. Reprinting version 3 today still shows what was new about version 3 in front of the client that day.
history.dev_notes: LedgerHtml uses releases.predecessorOf(version) for badges; deliberately different from the Markdown docs, which only mark the in-progress release.
